purpose: Preserve V172 quota-one terminal progress while eliminating arbitrary request-id capacity diversion by choosing the eligible heavy terminal player with the least immutable CPU work.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.supported: V172 exercised one deterministic admission in every active window, yet worsened throughput on five selected seeds relative to quota zero and missed the QPR sum. Request-id ordering is independent of resource cost, so it can spend the single quota on the most expensive heavy terminal chain. Selecting the least immutable CPU work is the strict outcome-blind minimizer of immediate compute diversion among the same eligible heavy players.
